notes.title: Ready Up: Rock the Rim Launches Any Moment! 🔥
notes.content:
[h2][b][i]Your story. Your rhythm. Your legacy.[/i][/b][/h2][h3]
The [i]first chapter[/i] of André’s journey — and yours — is about to begin. [/h3][p][/p][p]This isn’t just about basketball. It’s about the choices you make, the notes you hit, and the life you fight to define — on and off the court.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/3520cd7de312fbe80f1fdb79f7eff652505ac77e.png"][/img][/p][p]From intense court rivalries to private rehearsals and late-night writing sessions, [i]Rock the Rim[/i] blends the fire of competition with the soul of music. Every decision carries weight. Every beat matters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/5539769b2c43b2bf821bb7c13f078a450ecd5f7c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Original soundtrack, crafted to move you.
[/b][/h3][p][i]Rock the Rim[/i] features an evolving in-game soundtrack where characters express themselves through melody as much as through action. Whether it’s a quiet solo or an electrifying performance, music plays a central role in the journey ahead.
[/p][p]Stylized visuals, unforgettable characters, and a dual passion story told through both sound and sweat. Scroll down for new screenshots straight from the launch version.
[/p][p][i]This is your moment and it all begins right here.
[/i][/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522430/Rock_the_Rim/"]CLICK HERE TO WISHLIST & FOLLOW — DON’T MISS THE DROP.[/url][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YkZUPzFPAXA"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/-ENE_9ITolY"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_FSz-qf-kxM&pp=0gcJCb4JAYcqIYzv"][/dynamiclink][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/0b98aa17a2f7131365f3bf0cd046980190224f42.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/f4c9fc5d6571a5ef168edf7c0bad2c5d2c12636b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/755132e28d1f564c4f16e87fc8d1bee95dc370b1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/f33624085e2d3fb055e09b48a19dd887b5b9341a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/e7b0afdbc5b7f13b170251d47cf3aed80c223b1e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/d69485cdd61097e92c0d6cfe3ae898b1e538f063.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/3b22ab698c04600154f522c8b5e7affb887c86b3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/827665c5b995276412dc77fa8f54669ae28cf911.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/ee40d4843dbc3e68d9eb4ad6e69417524900cea2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/b906bf7c62d2ea9a94f4504034f2b4a5e1c44ef5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548146/f9bd70ac94bde5345770263ba3e461963de271ba.jpg"][/img][/carousel]
